notes: Single source of truth for AutoCAD host support, read by dcc_mcp_autocad.compat and shipped inside the wheel. `supported_ranges` entries carry machine evidence; `unverified_ranges` entries are declared so the doctor can name them, and are still rejected by default. A version outside both is rejected explicitly and never silently downgraded. The `id` of each range is the AutoCAD marketing year; `acadver` is the ObjectARX release it maps to.

supported_ranges.evidence: Real AutoCAD 2026 (ACADVER '25.1s (LMS Tech)') on Windows, exercised end to end during adapter evaluation: out-of-process COM round-trip (GetVariable DWGNAME/ACADVER/INSUNITS, ModelSpace, Layers, Layouts), LISP dispatch via doc.SendCommand read back through GetVariable("USERR1") = 42.0, 200x AddLine in 0.397s (~504 ops/s), SaveAs -> reopen -> 210 entities; headless accoreconsole.exe driven over stdin produced a valid AC1032 DWG that COM reopened as {'AcDbCircle': 1}.

unverified_ranges.reason: No machine has run this adapter against ACADVER 24.0. The vanilla COM surface it uses is long-stable, but 'long-stable' is an argument, not evidence.
No machine has run this adapter against ACADVER 24.1.
No machine has run this adapter against ACADVER 24.2.
The ProgID fallback chain can bind AutoCAD.Application.24.3, which proves the seat registers the version — not that the adapter's contract passes on it.
The ProgID fallback chain can bind AutoCAD.Application.25, but no contract run has been recorded against ACADVER 25.0.
Projected from Autodesk's annual cadence (25.1 = 2026). The mapping is an expectation, not an observation: no ACADVER 25.2 build has been inspected.

breaking_changes.title: accoreconsole.exe /s <script> does not consume the script
breaking_changes.symptom: accoreconsole.exe is launched with /s and never exits; no script runs and no DWG is produced. Absolute paths, relative paths, /i and /l en-US were all tried and all hung.
breaking_changes.remediation: The accoreconsole transport always pipes a CRLF-terminated script through stdin and never passes /s. Regression-tested by tests/test_core_console.py::test_uses_stdin_not_slash_s.

breaking_changes.title: makepy gen_py cache is incomplete (IAcadLine missing Color)
breaking_changes.symptom: Early binding through gencache.EnsureDispatch produces a stale gen_py cache that omits members such as IAcadLine.Color, so attribute access fails or silently resolves to nothing.
breaking_changes.remediation: The COM transport uses win32com.client.dynamic.Dispatch exclusively; the makepy cache is never consulted.

breaking_changes.title: COM calls are STA and rejected while AutoCAD is busy
breaking_changes.symptom: Calls during startup, a modal dialog, or a regeneration return RPC_E_CALL_REJECTED / RPC_E_SERVERCALL_RETRYLATER.
breaking_changes.remediation: com_retry re-issues only those two HRESULTs, bounded at 30 attempts x 0.5s; any other HRESULT propagates on the first call. Mutating calls additionally read back after the save, so a call that was dropped rather than retried surfaces as a read-back mismatch instead of a false success.
